title: Label-free fluorescent probe based on upconversion nanoparticles for convenient detection of cytochrome c
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42443-42449
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04602E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hong Zheng, Zhan Wu
We report a label-free fluorescent probe with poly(ethylene glycol)ylated phospholipid and triphenylphosphine-modified upconversion nanoparticles for specific cytochrome c detection. The cost-effective strategy is promising for clinical diagnostics.
